Getting started

Agent Page Extract turns a public webpage into clean markdown for a retrieval pipeline. The reader keeps the article body so a language model can quote the page without the surrounding chrome.

ALPHA-PHRASE-ARTICLE marks the sentence that should survive extraction. Teams paste this markdown into an assistant, a vector index, or a documentation crawl.

The same body can be returned as plain text when a pipeline wants words without heading marks. Word count and the token estimate both use that plain text, about four characters per token.

A documentation site can be walked a hop or two from the start URL. Links inside the article stay available when the caller asks for them.

Install the reader and External note sit in the body on purpose.
